snippet.title: Qianli: The Vastscape Scroll 丨 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Shape the world to your will in lush landscapes inspired by Chinese watercolors in this Zen hex-tile building game that blends puzzle and roguelite elements with beautiful Asian aesthetics. Befriend mystical creatures in your journey while you make the world come alive beneath your fingertips.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4358380/Qianli_The_Vastscape_Scroll/
